answer_1.quote: We conduct extensive experiments on seven datasets for three generation tasks on three distinct language model architectures, including a recent Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of M-RAG across diverse RAG baselines. In comparison to the best baseline approach, M-RAG exhibits improvements of 11%, 8%, and 12% for text summarization, machine translation, and dialogue generation tasks, respectively.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate the effectiveness of M-RAG in terms of the three generation tasks by following . ( ) For summa-rization, ROUGE (R-1/2/L) ) is used. (2) For machine translation, BLEU  is used. (3) For dialogue generation, BLEU (B-1/2) and Distinct (D-1/2)  are used.
